t: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
d: The Andromeda is haunted by a mysterious creature that comes aboard during a solar storm.

t: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
st: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
d: When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.
A more powerful Andromeda ship explodes due to likely sabotage, forcing Dylan's crew to save them.
Beka endangers both her crew and an entire planet when a former love shows up.

t: Andromeda: What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
st: What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
d: The Andromeda receives a cry for help from Rev Bam.
After a Commonwealth planet is attacked by Pyrian pyroformers, Dylan is forced to fight to protect the new planet.
Dylan hears voices beckoning him to a planet of "fire and ice."
While caught in a battle between two Nietzschean prides, the crew captures a hostile who claims that his pride possesses a map of the slipstream.
A wrong turn after exiting a slipstream sends the Andromeda into the Prolon system. They rescue an escape pod from certain disaster, but the pride wants it back.
The crew seeks for a lost colony of Nietzscheans and discovers another crew that has been secretly helping them.

t: Andromeda: Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
st: Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
d: The crew installs a new AI in a new Commonwealth battleship, and naturally things don't go as they should.

t: Andromeda: Shadows Cast by a Final Salute
st: Shadows Cast by a Final Salute
d: Tyr convinces the Nietzscheans that he is the reincarnation of Drago Museveni.

st: Answers Given to Questions Never Asked
d: A message from a collector sends Dylan on a quest to rescue a hostage and find the remains of the Commonwealth fleet.
Citizen Eight tries to remove Dylan from command of the Andromeda.
The crew must stop a world shipbuilder before he launches another invasion.
Dylan is kidnapped by Nietscheans and forced to play mind games for the amusement of his captors.
Two Nietzschean siblings are in a stand-off over a weapon that can eliminate higher brain functions.
